summary: Probe message prefix "ошибка чтения системных данных" is reused for clamscan launch, exit-code and file-access failures; CoreError also carries scan-domain variants inside the system module
evidence: system.rs:99-100; clamav.rs:77,83; files.rs:23; system.rs:1 module doc says system data only
failure_scenario: A clamscan launch failure shows "ошибка чтения системных данных" to the user.
